melee_grip.why: a melee handle: a closed fist

pointing.why: the index straight (the finger gun's index), the rest closed. The FBX has no one-finger point of its own

hold_magazine.why: a hand round a magazine body

hold_inserting.why: the heel of the hand driving a magazine home, fingers relaxed

hold_round.why: NO PINCH IN THE FBX: the nearest it has is the cup (index and middle folded at the middle joint, thumb in)

hold_slide.why: a hand closed on a slide to rack it

hold_forend.why: a hand wrapped round a pump
